questions_and_answers.question_text: What do you say when you want to get the attention of a waitress?
What do you say when you want to ask the waitress if the restaurant has an English menu?

answers.answer_text: Eego no menyuu wa arimasu ka?

questions_and_answers.question_text: What do you say when you want to ask the waitress to come with you to the plastic display?

answers.answer_text: Chotto issho ni kite kudasaimasen ka?

questions_and_answers.question_text: What do you say when you want to ask the waitress to bring you a knife and a fork?
What do you say when you want to ask someone to buy a meal ticket for you?
What do you say when you want to ask where the cashier is?

answers.answer_text: Okanjoo wa doko desu ka? (OR Reji wa doko desu ka?)

questions_and_answers.question_text: What do you say when you want to ask if they serve teriyaki?
What do you say when you want to order the same thing that someone else is eating?
What do you say when you want to ask the waitress to wait a moment, because you haven't decided what to order yet?
What do you say when you want to ask the waitress to bring you some tea?
What do you say when you want to order one dish of tempura?

answers.answer_text: Tenpura ichi-ninmae onegai shimasu. (OR Tenpura hitotsu onegai shimasu.)

questions_and_answers.question_text: What do you say when you want to make sure the dish you have selected is not salty?
What do you say when you want to order one more bottle of beer?
What do you say when you want to ask for a check?
What do you say when you want to thank the waitress/cashier on leaving the restaurant?
